notes: Compact mono derivative of pinned CC0 source recordings, not a full SFZ player.
Original region gains and MIDI velocity bands are preserved; quiet string/flute presets intentionally expand the selected soft layer across velocities.
Pizzicato extends the lowest original C2 zone by three semitones down to MIDI33; event pitch is retained.
No per-sample normalization. Piano retains three dynamics at selected six-semitone roots; no release-trigger samples or pedal simulation.
Sustained strings use explicitly derived crossfaded loops; all other instruments have finite natural decay with shortened tails.
Key ranges are explicit. Caller must use an explicit diagnostic fallback outside them; do not silently transpose/drop score notes.
Real browser, Android device, listening and full app acceptance remain separate gates.
